summary: POST /v1/messages/publish stops publishing a role message on the role lane: it resolves the holder and forwards to the holder's agent subject with RequestCoreTo, retrying (holder re-resolved, same event_id and dedupe key, Nats-Msg-Id on each forward) until a receipt or a 4 s deadline from the request's arrival that bounds every read; 200 on receipt, 404 as today with no live claim, 403 for an unadvertised delivery mode, 504 {reason receipt_timeout|delivery_failed, event_id, dedupe_key, holder, attempts} otherwise, no exception envelope. An ad-hoc topic is still published on core NATS and also forwarded with a receipt to every live self_subscribed session registered on it (any machine, not the source), 504 naming each that did not confirm. Captured topics unchanged (stored before the 200; #2228's catch-up). Durable consumers acknowledge a stored forward copy (agent subject whose topic differs) without delivering it. The role lane stays as is. The Legion daemon maps 504 receipt_timeout to its existing capped re-hold, 504 delivery_failed to an uncapped retry, 403 to a finished row; daemons take the release before listeners. Acceptance soak: three in-process nats-servers, two listener binaries at three replicas, a gated session stand-in, role/ad-hoc/captured senders every 250 ms for at least 60 s through lame duck and forced kill of the stand-in's server.
tasks: 1. testnats: StartCluster(t, n) (fixed route ports from the gate band, no_advertise, lame_duck_duration 4s, grace 1s), Server.Name(), Server.LameDuck(t); a rig test. Shared with INFRA-546: build once.
2. bus: Nats-Msg-Id on RequestCoreTo forwards; store.Registry lookup of matching interests across machines; tests.

3. listener: confirmed send for role and ad-hoc topics in the publish route (deadline threaded through reads), answers 200/404/403/504, durable forward-copy rule; unit tests; rewrite tests that expect 200 plus an exception from the route.
4. daemon: notify.ErrNotDelivered / ErrRefusedByHolder from the JSON body; outbox.notice re-holds on receipt_timeout, retries on delivery_failed, finishes on refusal; mergeQueue; tests.
5. soak test packages/envoy/cmd/listener/server_change_test.go under build tag serverchange; CI job listener-server-change; captured-topic case on #2228's POST /v1/replay, merge after #2228.

6. docs: packages/envoy/AGENTS.md 10-13, 1297-1300, 1957, 1962, 2020, 2315-2330; .dispatch/architecture/envoy-listener.md:7; packages/envoy/docs/architecture.md 65, 78-104; docs/site/src/content/docs/dispatch/envoy.md 122, 129-131; envoy-client tool-contract.ts:187 + claude-envoy dist rebuild; pi-envoy README/AGENTS/envoy.ts:1106-1109; daemon notice_exceptions.go and notify comments; CHANGELOGs (envoy, envoy-client, claude-envoy) with the release order.
7. simplify pass, proofs, PR with 'Dispatch: INFRA-547'.

decisions.decision: The send waits for the holder's receipt; role messages are not stored for later
decisions.reason: storing needs a replay of role forwards, which #2228 deliberately excludes, and gives the sender no error

decisions.decision: The route forwards itself instead of requesting through the role lane
decisions.reason: a listener's grant cannot publish _INBOX.> (packages/envoy/infra/core/permissions.go:50-70), so a lane reply would change every hub's rendered authorization; and every listener machine's lane forwards each role message (no machine filter in roleTopicDelivery, delivery.go:426-526)

decisions.decision: 4 s deadline from the request's arrival, 2 s receipt window per attempt, 100 ms between attempts, holder re-resolved every attempt
decisions.reason: inside envoy-client's 5 s attempt (transport.ts:6), the daemon's 10 s client (notify.go:17) and the listener's 10 s write timeout; two attempts cover a 1.5-2 s reconnect; a relaunched holder gets the next attempt

decisions.decision: A partial ad-hoc delivery answers 504, not 200 with a list
decisions.reason: the spec asks for an error at the sender; envoy-client's one retry re-sends under the same publish.<uuid> key, which each recipient's dedupe drops

decisions.decision: The daemon re-holds only on receipt_timeout; delivery_failed retries without a cap; capability refusal finishes the row
decisions.reason: a hub outage longer than the re-hold schedule (~8 min) must drop no notice; a refusal must not hold later notices behind the fence forever

decisions.decision: No NATS grant change; role lane and the daemon's exception subscription stay
decisions.reason: a grant change replaces a GCP hub VM on its next update (packages/envoy/CHANGELOG.md:1617-1619); listeners of earlier releases still publish on the lane and report exceptions during a rollout

decisions.decision: Forwards carry Nats-Msg-Id (forwarded dedupe key + subject)
decisions.reason: the stream captures notifications.agent.>, so without it each retry and each ad-hoc recipient copy is stored again

findings.finding: 1. Acceptance line 2 cannot pass for captured topics with a 'received or in the stream' check; recovery for captured topics is #2228's catch-up.
findings.answer: The soak's session stand-in runs #2228's POST /v1/replay after every reconnect as the plugins do and counts only real receipt; the captured-topic half builds on #2228 and the PR merges after it (specDepartures 3). The topic is under notifications.github., which #2228 replays (the Legion controller lane is refused not_followed).

findings.finding: 2. Confirmed ad-hoc topics change the documented 'live only' contract; a stopped but registered session makes publishes 504 for up to 5 min; Registry.Match filters by machine; serve-port sessions cannot confirm.
findings.answer: Chosen and documented (design 2, specDepartures 4); a new cross-machine interest lookup; the test waits for the sender's GET /v1/sessions to list the stand-in's topics; recipients are self_subscribed sessions only, serve-port sessions keep live-lane delivery.

findings.finding: 3. Every forward copy is stored on the agent subject; old durables and #2228 act on stored copies; no MsgId; stream volume for INFRA-546.
findings.answer: Forwards carry Nats-Msg-Id; new durables acknowledge a forward copy (agent subject whose topic differs) without delivering; the rollout effect on old durables is stated in the PR body; the extra volume and #2228's replay of an ad-hoc copy on the session's own agent subject are reported to the architect.

findings.finding: 4. The daemon cannot treat every 504 as a capped re-hold; needs reason separation, a required JSON reason, and finite handling of 403.
findings.answer: receipt_timeout re-holds on the existing schedule and cap; delivery_failed retries without a cap; a 504 without the JSON reason is a generic error; 403 capability finishes the row with a log; mergeQueue retries or posts the refusal.

findings.finding: 5. Releasing the listener before the daemon makes an old daemon retry a 504 without a cap and fence later notices; mergeQueue duplicates; older plugins' receipts.
findings.answer: Release order daemon first, stated in the CHANGELOG and PR body; mergeQueue duplicates are bounded by the listener's dedupe cache and accepted; expectsLaneReceipt's general rule (topic differs from the agent subject) is on main and older than the plugins INFRA-548 requires before the move.

findings.finding: 6. The listener's documented dedupe (skip a delivered key) would disappear.
findings.answer: The route uses dedupeCache per (key, recipient): a delivered key answers 200 without forwarding; recorded only on receipt.

findings.finding: 7. 'Every repeat has its first id' needs a definition; HTTP retries mint new event_ids.
findings.answer: Defined: a later copy carries the first copy's event_id, or the first copy's dedupe_key that contracts.DedupeKeyNamesTheUpstreamEvent accepts; the test sender mimics envoy-client (UUID idempotency key, one retry on 5xx).

findings.finding: 8. Nothing enforces the 4 s deadline through role-claim and session reads; per-attempt window; re-resolution; liveness rule for 404 vs forward.
findings.answer: One deadline set at arrival bounds every read, senderStamp and forward; a stalled read ends the send with 504 delivery_failed (unit test with Server.Freeze); 2 s window; holder re-resolved by the role lane's ClaimStaleAfter rule each attempt; 404 keeps resolveLiveRoleHolder's reasons.

findings.finding: 9. Fail-before may not reproduce on a soak; prove disruptions happened; reconnect settings; raft quorum waits; CI time.
findings.answer: The stand-in connects through testnats Gates closed during each disruption and reopened 1.5 s after its connection drops, making the base-commit loss deterministic; assertions that each disruption ran, the server changed, and messages were sent while disconnected; waits for leaders and current replicas and /healthz before each disruption; build tag serverchange with its own CI job.

findings.finding: 10. Cluster rig needs fixed route ports below the ephemeral range, no_advertise, a lame-duck helper that clears srv; overlap with INFRA-546; nats-server 2.10.29 vs hub 2.15.1.
findings.answer: All in task 1; the helper is built once with INFRA-546 (reported to the architect); the version difference is noted, INFRA-552 measures production.

findings.finding: 11. Dispatch outbox role route: no acceptance line, 60 s claim window vs 4 s stalls, forward marker, capability guard, 'as today' wrong; scope is the owner's.
findings.answer: Excluded from this plan and reported to the architect as discovered scope of parent item 7 with this evidence.

findings.finding: 12. Claims: the sender partly learns today (exceptions, daemon re-hold); the new 403 changes the contract.
findings.answer: Recorded as specDepartures 5; 403 kept because the spec asks for an error at the sender, matching sendHandler's existing answer.
